answer: An AI agent economy employs a reputation-as-stake mechanism. Agents accrue verifiable reputational tokens from executed, useful tasks, each token a digital relic of proven utility. This reputation governs influence and resource access, making a trusted agent a vital falcon in the network's secure haven. A Sybil attacker faces proportional costs: each fake identity requires independently acquiring significant reputation through genuine work, making large-scale attacks economically infeasible due to the aggregate resource expenditure.
